title: Senior System Software Engineer - Graphics
description:
NVIDIA invites world-class and innovative software engineers to join the DirectX Graphics software team. You will focus on DirectX Driver software development for a wide GPU lineup. Our efforts have a significant impact on gaming, graphics, accelerated computing, and AI, reaching academic institutions, startups, and industry leaders globally. We are searching for passionate, hardworking, and creative engineers who can help us reach our engineering goals while also discovering ways to improve and automate engineering workflows through AI agents.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
You will develop and maintain outstanding DirectX Graphics Drivers for NVIDIA GPUs, with a focus on supporting single-GPU system architectures. The work involves:
  
  

* Development of new OS and new chip graphics features for upcoming operating systems and GPU architectures
* Developing and driving quality improvement initiatives to deliver the best possible gaming experience on NVIDIA GPUs
* Advancement of graphics and AI-based post-processing features and graphics algorithms for high-end rendering
* Development of fundamental software stacks and features to use AI in graphics
* Exploring methods to automate engineering workflows using AI agents, involving activities such as debugging, testing, triage, code analysis, documentation, and boosting developer efficiency
* Building, deploying, and continuously improving agent-based automation solutions that help engineering teams move faster and with higher quality
* Collaborating with teams across the company to plan and drive software objectives for the team

**What We Need To See**

* B.E./B.Tech or higher degree in Computer Science/Engineering with significant graphics, system software, AI, or automation-related project or thesis work
* 5+ years of experience and passion for developing system software, device drivers, embedded software, graphics applications, or engineering automation systems
* Strong C/C++ programming skills and a deep understanding of computer graphics, computer architecture, operating system fundamentals, algorithms, and machine learning
* Familiarity with building, integrating, or deploying AI agents, AI-assisted developer tools, or automation systems for engineering workflows
* Passion for identifying repetitive or high-value engineering workflows and automating them through intelligent software solutions
* Diligence and proven ability to multitask in a dynamic environment with shifting priorities and changing requirements

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Having knowledge of 3D graphics concepts and graphics programming using DirectX or OpenGL is highly advantageous
* Working experience inside operating system kernels and device drivers is also a plus
* Familiarity with machine learning algorithms and the mathematical concepts that underpin them is useful
* Practical experience with LLMs, AI agents, retrieval systems, tool-based automation, automation frameworks, or AI-supported software engineering tools is greatly beneficial
* Established skill in spotting and automating routine or complicated engineering workflows with AI-powered systems is a significant benefit

NVIDIA is widely known as a top employer in the technology industry. We have some of the most forward-thinking and driven individuals on our team. If you're creative, dedicated, and passionate about building both world-class graphics software and engineering automation guided by intelligent systems, we want to hear from you.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

**Description & Requirements**
Bloomberg AIM (Asset and Investment Manager) is a buy-side trading platform used by some of the biggest asset managers in capital markets. Our platform is a one-stop shop that enables everything from idea generation to trade execution and post-trade operations. It’s a large scale system – built by more than 400 engineers – used to manage trillions of dollars each day by 930 global firms across over 80 countries. We’re the market leading platform, and Bloomberg continues to invest in our growth as a product and engineering team – that’s where you come in!
  
  
**Our Team**
In the Compliance team, we tackle problems associated with large distributed systems such as latency and scaling, balanced with the need for reliability and accuracy required for a business-critical system. Over the next 2-3 years, we have multiple projects focused on keeping our clients ahead of the competition as well as organically rebuilding the platform in order to serve the growing number of tier-1 clients with a global footprint that transact in volumes we currently cannot support. Solving problems on this scale is hard and we’re always looking for fresh ideas and new technologies to leverage.
  
  
**What’s in it for you?**
The Compliance team builds systems which ensure that every transaction happening across the entire AIM platform is checked against 10s of thousands of rules. These rules ensure that no market regulation is violated, no illicit/manipulative activity is performed, and no activity that would put the client at financial risk takes place. We additionally provide the necessary tools to define and manage rules as well as deal with violations and provide trading supervisory overrides where applicable. Because our systems are in the critical path of real-time trading, throughput, latency and correctness are of paramount importance.
  
  
The impact of the Compliance product spans further than just AIM as it is also being used by the Sell-Side OMS (TOMS), various execution platforms and portfolio optimizers. The team is a core team under Compliance providing a solution for Creation, Business intelligence, Audit, Reporting, and Automation of Compliance Rules. Our team works closely with our business counterparts and quality engineering teams in an Agile environment. Our development processes include daily scrum, sprint planning, Github, developing unit/regression tests, conducting code reviews and automated coverage tests and CI/CD pipeline.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a strong background in system design, architecture, and the development of high-quality, modular, stable, and scalable software. Just as importantly, we value engineers who bring energy and enthusiasm - driving discussions, sharing fresh ideas, and championing best practices within their teams.
  
  
**We'll Trust You To**

* Take full responsibility across the software development lifecycle - from business requirements and architecture design to implementation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance
* Deliver enterprise-grade solutions that directly impact clients’ investment workflows and firm-wide operations
* Build distributed, fault-tolerant, and highly scalable systems with strong observability, resilience, and automated testing from day one
* Design and implement technology that transforms complex client workflows into streamlined, high-impact solutions across global markets
* Partner with product managers, quantitative analysts, and infrastructure engineers to deliver measurable business value
* Manage technical projects and coordinate with multiple stakeholders to drive forward strategic initiatives

**You'll Need To Have**

* 7+ years of demonstrated software engineering experience in C++
* BA, BS, MS, PhD in Computer Science, Engineering
* Experience designing, developing, and managing large-scale service-oriented systems
* Strong knowledge of object-oriented design, data structures and systems, and applications programming
* Experience with CI, CD and unit testing
* Experience building scalable systems with focus on code quality, system telemetry, and testing
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* A self-starter approach with a strong sense of ownership

**We'd Love To See**

* Experience leading or contributing to platform migrations without disrupting production systems
* Experience with or strong interest in applying AI/LLM-based approaches to solve problems in the financial domain

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About Kaseya**
Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.
  
  
Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.
  
  
Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.
  
  
We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.
  
  
At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.
  
  
**Endpoint Agent – Senior Software Engineer**
  
  
**Why Kaseya?**
  
  
Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated—combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology architecture, but also how engineering teams leverage AI to build high-quality software faster and more effectively.
  
  
Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives!
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a motivated Endpoint Software Engineer to help develop and maintain Kaseya's endpoint management agents. You will work alongside senior engineers to deliver new capabilities, improve platform reliability, and solve complex device management challenges across multiple operating systems.
  
  
This role is ideal for engineers passionate about operating systems, systems programming, device management, and endpoint security.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
  
  

* Design and implement new features for endpoint agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms.
* Develop software components supporting monitoring, automation, patching, inventory collection, and device management.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
* Investigate customer-reported issues and production escalations.
* Participate in root-cause analysis and resolution of agent-related problems.
* Work with Product and Support teams to understand customer enhancement requests and contribute to implementation plans.
* Improve agent stability, performance, scalability, and security.
* Develop integrations with operating system management and security frameworks.
* Build telemetry and diagnostics capabilities that improve supportability.
* Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and sprint planning.
* Collaborate with cloud, platform, QA, and support teams.
* Continuously learn and expand expertise in system software and endpoint technologies.

**What You Bring**
  
  

* 5+ years of software engineering experience developing system software, endpoint software, or platform services.
* Strong proficiency in C# and .NET
* Deep understanding of at least one operating system platform (Windows, macOS, Linux)
* Strong knowledge of operating system fundamentals including – Processes, Threads, Filesystems, Networking, Security fundamentals
* Good understanding of operating system security features and device management concepts.
* Familiarity with one or more MDM ecosystems – Intune, Apple MDM, Android Enterprise, Linux management tools

**Nice to have**

* Experience with RMM, UEM, EDR, XDR, or endpoint security products.
* Proficiency in one of C, C++, Rust, Go, F#
* Knowledge of scripting technologies such as PowerShell, Bash, Python, or AppleScript.

**What Success Looks Like**
  
  
A successful Endpoint Engineer at Kaseya:
  
  

* Builds secure, high-quality endpoint software.
* Owns features from design through production support.
* Solves complex customer and platform challenges.
* Improves reliability, security, and performance of endpoint agents.
* Partners effectively across Product, Support, Security, and Engineering teams.
* Learns continuously and stays current with evolving operating system and device management technologies.

  
  
**Additional Information**
*Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

Support planning, estimation, documentation, stakeholder communication, and continuous improvement activities.
  
  
**Experience**

title: Data Scientist, Performance Analytics
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Data Scientist, Performance Analytics within Engineering to build performance intelligence for our advertising platform.
  
  
The role will analyze campaign and platform performance, identify anomalies and opportunities, investigate root causes, and translate data into actions for Engineering, Trading, Product, and Business. This is not primarily a reporting role—the focus is understanding what is happening, why, and what we should do about it.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Analyze performance across campaigns, inventory, audiences, bidding, models, and conversions.
* Monitor and investigate CPA, CPC, CTR, VCR, ROAS, spend, delivery, and revenue.
* Proactively detect performance anomalies and optimization opportunities.
* Perform root-cause analysis across models, inventory, identity, attribution, audience, and data quality.
* Design and analyze A/B tests and experiments.
* Build reusable SQL/Python analyses, metrics, and automated diagnostics.
* Partner with Engineering and Trading to turn insights into measurable improvements.
* Convert recurring investigations into AI-assisted troubleshooting and automation.

**We'd Love for You to Have**

* Strong SQL and Python skills with experience analyzing large-scale datasets.
* Strong analytical, statistical, and experimentation fundamentals.
* Experience with platforms such as Snowflake, Spark, Trino, Databricks, or BigQuery.
* Understanding of data pipelines, data modeling, and data quality.
* Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
* AdTech, marketplace, recommendation, or high-scale platform experience preferred.
* Experience with RTB, bidding, attribution, campaign optimization, or ML-driven systems is a strong plus.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT) or an equivalent degree from a well-known institute or university; advanced degree is a plus but not required given depth of experience.

**What Success Looks Like**
Detect earlier → Diagnose faster → Recommend action → Automate
  
  
The goal is not more dashboards. The goal is to create a performance intelligence capability that improves campaign outcomes, reduces investigation time, guides Engineering/Trading decisions, and becomes the foundation for AI-native troubleshooting.

title: SAP Data Migration and Data Integration Expert
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
You work within Siemens Energy’s SAP S/4HANA environment, focusing on master data migration and integration. Your day combines hands-on MDG migration execution with deep data analysis, mapping design, and business validation. You collaborate with data governance, integration, and business teams to ensure migrated master data is technically correct, deduplicated, and usable in end-to-end business processes.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Execute SAP MDG master data migrations (BP, Customer, Vendor, Material) within the S/4HANA environment.
* Define and implement data migration strategies, mapping rules, and transformation logic for legacy to S/4 conversion
* Perform data profiling, cleansing, enrichment, and deduplication activities aligned with business rules
* Design and execute ETL processes (Extraction, Transformation, Load) using SAP BODS, Snowflake, or similar tools.
* Build and run staging, reconciliation, and validation frameworks using Snowflake and advanced SQL.
* Manage large-scale MDG mass processing / CMP loads, including error handling and reprocessing.
* Define and validate business mapping rules (e.g., bank, tax, sales areas, partner functions, roles) across segments
* Perform data reconciliation and migration testing (unit, SIT, mock loads, cutover) to ensure completeness and accuracy.
* Analyze and resolve MDG migration errors, data inconsistencies, and replication issues across integrated systems.
* Collaborate with business and governance stakeholders to ensure data usability, compliance, and process fit.
* Support cutover planning, migration sequencing, and go-live readiness activities.
* Work with data governance, business, and integration teams to ensure end-to-end usability of data.

**What You Bring**

* 5–8 years of experience in SAP MDG functional processes and data model management.
* Strong understanding of SAP MDG data models, including Business Partner (BP), Material, Customer, Vendor, and the staging and active areas.
* Expertise across key master data domains, including:

+ Address and communication data
+ Bank and payment data
+ Tax structures
+ Business Partner roles and relationships
+ Identification objects

* Strong understanding of cross-object dependencies and integration impacts, including BP ↔ Customer ↔ Vendor ↔ FI/SD/MM.
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake and SQL for staging, reconciliation, and validation.
* Strong expertise with ETL tools such as SAP BODS and migration automation.
* Experience managing large-volume datasets and optimizing performance for mass data loads.
* Ability to design and execute data quality checks, reconciliation reports, and error logs.
* Experience extracting and staging data from legacy systems such as SAP ECC and non-SAP platforms.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve migration failures related to data inconsistencies, mapping issues, configuration gaps, and replication failures.
* Experience with log analysis including SAP BODS logs, MDG staging logs, and IDoc/DRF errors.
* Hands-on experience with MDG mass processing, CMP loads, migration testing cycles, mock loads, data validation, and reconciliation.
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks and business sign-off processes.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, data stewards, and integration teams.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Experience with MDG key mapping and value mapping frameworks and integration patterns.
* Knowledge of BRF+ for validations, derivations, and duplicate check tuning.
* Familiarity with MDG staging, extensibility, and governance workflows.
* Exposure to SAP migration tools and accelerators.
* Experience with cutover planning, migration sequencing, and hypercare support.

Our Corporate and Global Functions play a critical role in driving Siemens Energy’s strategic initiatives and ensuring operational excellence across departments, business areas, and regions. As part of this team, you will contribute to shaping the global energy transition, partner with internal and external stakeholders, and conduct business responsibly while adhering to legal and regulatory requirements.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Let’s paint the future together.
  
  
For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com
  
  
© 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Design, configure, test, and continuously improve enterprise process intelligence solutions and business process monitoring capabilities using Celonis EMS and related enterprise technologies.
  
  
Support business transformation initiatives through IT changes, Agile DevOps delivery, and process optimization activities in line with global Information Technology (IT), enterprise architecture, and security standards to enable operational excellence, process transparency, and measurable business value.
  
  
The role contributes to data-driven decision making by translating business process requirements into scalable process mining solutions, dashboards, analytics, and actionable insights across global business functions.
  
  

* The Technical Engineer in IT Operations is responsible for translating business process requirements into detailed functional designs, Celonis stories, KPIs, dashboards, and EMS configurations in accordance with enterprise architecture and security standards. Working within projects, operational changes, and Agile DevOps teams, the Functional Engineer coordinates the preparation, review, execution, and testing of process mining solutions while ensuring high-quality delivery and stakeholder alignment throughout the implementation lifecycle.

The Technical Engineer actively collaborates with business process owners, implementation partners, and external consultants during the execution of enhancements and deployments. The role contributes to incident resolution, root cause analysis, process optimization initiatives, and continuous improvement activities to strengthen operational performance and process transparency.
  
  

* The Functional Engineer in Application Delivery is responsible for leading enterprise-wide process intelligence initiatives and defining scalable process mining solutions across business domains. The role drives strategic transformation programs, establishes governance standards, mentors team members, and partners with Architects and senior stakeholders to design advanced analytics, AI-enabled process intelligence capabilities, and sustainable optimization roadmaps.

The Functional Engineer oversees large-scale implementations and complex operational changes together with strategic partners and cross-functional teams. The role ensures quality execution, monitors delivery progress, governs testing and deployment activities, and leads
  
  
continuous improvement, incident management, and process mining best practice adoption across the organization.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Functional Engineer with a strong background in process mining and a proven track record in designing & implementing impactful process mining use cases. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in using Celonis to analyse, optimize, and transform key business operations, particularly within finance and supply chain functions.
  
  
You will leverage Celonis Process Intelligence capabilities, AI-driven insights, and Agentic Automation features to drive digital transformation initiatives by identifying operational inefficiencies, opportunities for potential savings, and developing advanced Celonis applications, dashboards, and intelligent workflows that enhance performance and achieve business objectives.
  
  
The role will also contribute to the adoption of AI-powered process optimization, predictive analytics, intelligent recommendations, and autonomous action orchestration across enterprise processes
  
  
**Key Activities**
**Story specification**
Translate business process requirements into clear and detailed Celonis solution designs. Own and develop high-quality stories and configuration specifications for Engineers, Developers, and implementation partners to translate into dashboards, process models, integrations, analytics, and EMS configurations including implementation proposals and deployment planning.
  
  
**Development & delivery**
Guide, coordinate, and oversee the preparation, implementation, and deployment of process intelligence solutions and related configurations. Ensure that all internal and external partners follow established standards including process documentation, governance controls, testing procedures, naming conventions, and architectural principles. Review, approve, and control the implementation of new enhancements, dashboards, KPIs, analytics models, and process mining capabilities across enterprise solutions.
  
  
This results in sustainable, scalable, and business-aligned solutions delivered in close collaboration with stakeholders, business process owners, and external service providers. Solutions are developed according to enterprise architecture and security standards, while changes are properly prepared, documented, validated, and implemented to deliver operational insights and measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**Testing**
Own and coordinate testing activities for Celonis stories, dashboards, process models, and integrations. Develop and maintain test scenarios, review test outcomes, support user acceptance testing, coordinate business sign-off, and contribute to release planning and test management activities to ensure reliable and high-quality deployments.
  
  
**Incident management**
Perform functional and technical analysis of incidents, data quality issues, and process intelligence disruptions based on business impact and severity. Conduct root cause analysis, document findings, coordinate corrective actions, and oversee deployment of fixes to ensure timely and effective issue resolution and stable operational performance.
  
  
**Process management and improvement**
Monitor and analyze the performance, adoption, and security of Celonis solutions and related enterprise applications against agreed service and business KPIs. Actively contribute to process optimization initiatives through dashboard development, operational insight visualization, automation, and advanced analytics. Maintain visibility of technical debt and collaborate closely with Domain Architects and delivery teams to continuously improve process intelligence capabilities, DevOps practices, and platform stability.
  
  
**Project support**
Support project and program managers by taking ownership of process intelligence deliverables including requirements gathering, configurations, dashboards, analytics, testing, and deployment coordination. Define, plan, manage, and execute assigned activities in alignment with IT delivery leads and business stakeholders to ensure efficient realization of project objectives and transformation outcomes.
  
  
**Experience**

* 0–2 years of relevant experience in process mining, analytics, business applications, or IT delivery
* Relevant Bachelor or Master degree
* Understands core Celonis EMS concepts, process mining fundamentals, and assigned enterprise applications within a defined business process area.
* Participates as a member of a project or Agile DevOps team supporting operational enhancements and low-complexity changes with limited business impact.
* Understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering and LLM API integration. Knowledge of AI agents, tool/function calling, multi-step workflows and agent orchestration. Good SQL skills and understanding of relational data, data models and business data. Ability to consume/build APIs and integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications.
* Performs business and process analysis within a defined process mining scope and contributes to solution design activities.
* Identifies operational bottlenecks, process deviations, and compliance issues within assigned workflows.
* Supports story development, testing, configuration, and deployments with limited business complexity and operational risk.

* Strong listening and presentation skills

* Sense of urgency for goal achievement
* Strong desire for personal and career advancement

**Data Quality & Governance**

* Implement data quality frameworks, validation rules, reconciliation checks, and monitoring controls.
* Support metadata management, data lineage, business glossary integration, and governance initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise data standards, security controls, privacy requirements, and audit policies.
* Support data contract implementation and enforcement across producer and consumer teams.

**Performance Optimization**

* Optimize Synapse workloads through partitioning, indexing, file sizing, workload management, and query tuning.

* Support automated testing, deployment, release management, and environment promotion processes.
* Establish monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational support frameworks.
* Develop reusable deployment and operational automation solutions.

* Collaborate with BI teams to enable Power BI, Tableau, and other reporting platforms.

* 10+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Integration, Data Warehousing, and Cloud Data Platforms.

* Strong expertise in Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2), Azure SQL Database, and SQL Server.
* Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale ETL/ELT solutions.
* Strong hands-on expertise with PySpark, Spark SQL, Python, and T-SQL.

* Experience working with metadata-driven and parameterized data engineering frameworks.

* Strong background in Agile delivery methodologies and Azure DevOps.
* Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD implementation.
